dataItem-lvww21pm1.text: Embark on a 5-day Serengeti Romantic Escape Safari, crafted to immerse you in the beauty of Tanzania's most iconic landscapes. This journey combines the adventure of exploring Lake Manyara, Central Serengeti, Northern Serengeti, and the Ngorongoro Crater, with the luxury of your private safari vehicle. Each day unfolds new discoveries, from the vibrant wildlife of the Serengeti plains to the lush greenery of Lake Manyara and the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater. Whether it's the thrill of witnessing the Great Migration or the tranquil moments shared under a starlit sky, this intimate safari is designed to create unforgettable memories for two.

dataItem-lvww21pt3.text: ​

dataItem-lvww21pu4.text:
Day 1: Arrival in Arusha
Upon arrival, you'll be greeted at the airport by your warm and knowledgeable Mazingira Safari private guide, who will whisk you away to your charming lodge in Arusha. Unwind at your lodge by basking in the lush tropical forest and vibrant gardens, swimming in the inviting 30-meter pool, or taking a romantic nature walk to discover the indigenous flora and fauna. Spot Sykes and Colobus monkeys or listen to the symphony of birdsong surrounding you. To further elevate your experience, consider a serene boat ride or try your hand at croquet while savoring a refreshing sundowner. As the sun sets, delight in a romantic dinner under the forest canopy, basking in the magic of the African night. This tranquil day prepares you for the thrilling adventures ahead on your romantic safari.

dataItem-lvww21q7.text:
Day 1: Lake Manyara

After breakfast around 8:00 a.m., your safari guide will pick you up from the lodge and head to Lake Manyara National Park, a scenic two-hour drive away. This park, though compact at 205 square miles, boasts lush acacia forests, giant figs, mahogany trees, and thriving populations of baboons and blue monkeys. It's also a haven for giraffes, elephants, impalas, buffaloes, and hippos, offering unforgettable photo opportunities with giraffes and buffaloes framed by the shimmering lake. After a day of wildlife exploration, you'll immerse yourself in Maasai culture with a visit to a traditional boma, gaining insight into their unique way of life. As evening falls, unwind with a candlelit bubble bath, sparkling wine, and a cheese platter before indulging in a romantic dinner meticulously set up at your hotel—a perfect end to a remarkable day.

dataItem-lvww21qg4.text:
Day 3: Serengeti National Park

Embark on a game drive to Serengeti National Park, a journey of about 305 km that will take approximately three hours. Feel the warm welcome of Serengeti's iconic endless plains, where wildlife roams in unmatched abundance. You'll spend the day in the central Seronera area, a wildlife-rich habitat sustained by the Seronera River, which attracts a wide variety of resident species. Here, you can observe elephants, giraffes, impalas, waterbucks, hippos, reedbucks, buffaloes, and baboons, who thrive in this region even after the famous wildebeest migration has moved on. After a thrilling day of game viewing, retreat to the luxurious Lodge for a romantic dinner and an overnight stay.

dataItem-lvww21qp4.text:
Day 4: Serengeti National Park - Ngorongoro Conservancy

​

Enjoy breakfast at your lodge before continuing your game drive in Serengeti National Park. Your expert safari guide will lead you to the best wildlife spotting locations, including a visit to the hippo pool, where you can watch these massive creatures lounge in the cool water alongside crocodiles. The diverse landscape offers unparalleled game viewing opportunities to observe giraffes, zebras, wildebeests, lions, and with luck, leopards and cheetahs. The park is also home to a vibrant bird population, including secretary birds and flightless ostriches. For a unique perspective, consider a breathtaking balloon safari to witness the sweeping plains and wildlife from the skies.

After an exhilarating day, you'll head to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area for an overnight stay, ready for the next adventure.

dataItem-lvww21qw5.text:
Day 5: Ngorongoro Crater

​

Get up early for your breakfast, later you will sit back at your safety and comfort private safari vehicle and enjoy the journey on the Great Rift Valley through crater forest to your destination of the striking Ngorongoro crater. The crater is the most visited destination and one of the Africa’s Seven Natural wonders. It is the home to the highest concentration of wildlife in Africa, full of elephants, lions, buffaloes, hippos and even the rare black rhino. In additional to the game, Ngorongoro also offers an adds bucket list to activities including traditional Maasai village, Laetoli footprints, the oldest known footprints of early humans approximately 3.5 years old. 

Later you will drive back to Arusha and being transferred to the airport for your departure back home or an extension to Zanzibar.
